title.zh: 熵：生成留下历史，不需前提；守住历史有代价：无损的交换可以不息而复返，有限围住的水平没有箭头，箭头或静止合并构型，把记录放在守恒量之中恰是每次交换的最小损失
title.en: Entropy: becoming leaves a history with no premise, and holding it costs: lossless exchange can go on and come back, the levels of a finite enclosure have no arrow, an arrow or rest merges configurations, and the record held in the conserved amount is exactly the least loss per exchange

claim.zh: 不加前提：平衡的流中一个成员的水平每次变化都是与家族的交换（Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_change）；家族自 T 起交换的历史（Flow.history）从不缩减（Flow.history_mono）；一次交换连同其逆转（Flow.Reverses：同样的形成参与，各取其所给、给其所取）恢复每个水平，历史却记下两次（Flow.Balances.restores_levels_not_history）。零：第一律在固定单位下是无中不生有（Flow.Gainless），无损是恰好得回（Flow.Lossless），耗散是第一律加最小损失（Flow.Dissipative.gainless）；第一律之下逆转在规律之内恰当原交换无损（Flow.Reverses.gainlessOn_iff），耗散之下没有交换被逆转（Flow.Dissipative.irreversible）；Passing 有限、平衡、无损、每步被围住，交换在下一步被逆转，生起与止息复现，历史每步增长一（Passing.passes、Passing.history_grows）。记录：把交换的记录算作只被给予、不被取用的条件（Flow.withRecord、Web.withRecord；算入记录的平衡与原平衡相同，整体与每步每个家族都如此：Flow.balances_withRecord、Flow.balancesOn_withRecord），流在一步上耗散于家族，恰当有某个记录使每次交换精确守恒家族连同其记录并给记录至少一个单位（Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_conserved），也恰当以一个单位记录每次交换时家族连同记录不得增益（Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_unitRecord、Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_recorded、Flow.Dissipative.of_recorded）；两部分都需要（Passing.record_needs_both）；第一律之下记录收到的恰是家族失去的（Flow.GainlessOn.residues_lost）。耗散的量（Flow.dissipated）从不减少，第一律之下连同存量守恒（Flow.Balances.stock_dissipated），历史在其内（Flow.Balances.history_within），按比例 q 耗散时被取走的至多是它的 q+1 倍（Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost、Flow.uptake_within_dissipated）。构型：第一律之下家族的构型在其存量的构型之内，configurations n K 恰好一次列出 K 个单位落入 n 个成员的每种方式（configurations_exact）；从不复返（Web.Revisits）则变化的步数不多于这些构型而归于静止（Flow.Balances.changes_within、changes_within_lossless、rests_of_never_revisits），所以不止的变化复返（Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits、World.arising_revisits），耗散之下从不复返（Flow.Balances.never_revisits）。箭头：构型的量从不下降、每次变化都上升（Web.Arrow）就排除复返（Web.never_revisits_of_arrow），所以第一律之下箭头带来静止（Flow.Balances.rests_of_arrow），变化继续时没有箭头（Flow.Balances.no_arrow、World.no_arrow、Passing.no_arrow）。合并：变化是构型的函数时（Web.Determined），变化之后静止合并两个构型，不用流的规律（Web.merges_of_settles、Web.Merges）；不合并则变化不停（Web.changes_persist），第一律之下复返（Flow.Balances.revisits_of_apart）；从不复返、有箭头或被耗散时不是不合并（Flow.Balances.merges_of_never_revisits、merges_of_arrow、merges_of_dissipates）。守住历史：构型承载历史（Flow.CarriesHistory）时其读数是箭头（Flow.Balances.arrow_of_carries），第一律之下交换在构型的个数之内停止（Flow.Balances.exchange_stops_of_carries），有限世界不停交换就遗忘（World.forgets）。Gathering：精确守恒、每步被围住，记录的水平永远上升，从外部得益，世界不有限（Gathering.gathers）。六律的实例（R6，Becoming.Recurrence）：变化之后的复返是复返（Web.Revisits.recurs），箭头标记每次变化（Web.Arrow.marks），沿家族的合并是规律的合并（Web.Merges.law），确定的变化沿规律的轨道（Web.Determined.orbit）；第一律把构型限于其 T 时存量之内的构型（Flow.Balances.held，这一界限是前提 Z），所以从每步起构型构造性地两次取同一值（Flow.Balances.recurs），箭头使变化停止（Flow.Balances.arrow_stops），在这一界限之内不合并的规律带回起点（Flow.Balances.returns_of_lossless；起作用的是界限而不是不合并：Law.succ_open 不合并且永不回返），当下遗忘所保留的历史（Flow.Balances.present_forgets），箭头或耗散排除不合并的规律（Flow.Balances.not_lossless_of_arrow、not_lossless_of_dissipates）。
claim.en: With no premise: in a balanced flow every change of a member's level is an exchange with the family (Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_change); the history of the family's exchanges since T (Flow.history) never shrinks (Flow.history_mono); an exchange with its reverse (Flow.Reverses: the same formations, each taking what it gave and giving what it took) restores every level, while the history counts both (Flow.Balances.restores_levels_not_history). Zero: the first law at a fixed unit is nothing from nothing (Flow.Gainless), losing nothing is getting back exactly (Flow.Lossless), and dissipation is the first law with a least loss (Flow.Dissipative.gainless); under the first law a reverse is within the law exactly where the exchange is lossless (Flow.Reverses.gainlessOn_iff), and under dissipation no exchange is reversed (Flow.Dissipative.irreversible); Passing is finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed at every step, each exchange reversed at the next, arising and ceasing recurring, its history growing by one at every step (Passing.passes, Passing.history_grows). The record: with the record of the exchanges counted as a condition given to and never taken from (Flow.withRecord, Web.withRecord; balance with the record counted is balance, as a whole and at each step on each family: Flow.balances_withRecord, Flow.balancesOn_withRecord), a flow dissipates on a family across a step exactly where, for some record, every exchange conserves the family with its record exactly and leaves the record at least one unit (Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_conserved), and exactly where, recording each exchange at one unit, the family with its record gains nothing (Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_unitRecord, Flow.dissipatesOn_iff_recorded, Flow.Dissipative.of_recorded); both parts are needed (Passing.record_needs_both); under the first law the record receives exactly what the family loses (Flow.GainlessOn.residues_lost). The amount dissipated (Flow.dissipated) never falls, with the stock it is conserved under the first law (Flow.Balances.stock_dissipated), the history is within it (Flow.Balances.history_within), and under loss in proportion q everything taken is at most q + 1 times it (Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost, Flow.uptake_within_dissipated). Configurations: under the first law the family's configuration stays among its stock's configurations, configurations n K listing each way K units fall into n members exactly once (configurations_exact); never revisiting (Web.Revisits), it changes at most that many times and rests (Flow.Balances.changes_within, changes_within_lossless, rests_of_never_revisits), so change without end revisits (Flow.Balances.unending_change_revisits, World.arising_revisits), and under dissipation a family never revisits (Flow.Balances.never_revisits). The arrow: a quantity of the configuration that never falls and rises at every change (Web.Arrow) rules out revisiting (Web.never_revisits_of_arrow), so under the first law an arrow brings rest (Flow.Balances.rests_of_arrow) and while change goes on there is none (Flow.Balances.no_arrow, World.no_arrow, Passing.no_arrow). Merging: where change is a function of the configuration (Web.Determined), rest after a change merges two configurations, with no law of the flow (Web.merges_of_settles, Web.Merges); merging none, change never stops (Web.changes_persist) and under the first law revisits (Flow.Balances.revisits_of_apart); never revisiting, under an arrow or under dissipation, it is not the case that it merges none (Flow.Balances.merges_of_never_revisits, merges_of_arrow, merges_of_dissipates). Holding the history: where the configuration carries the history (Flow.CarriesHistory), its reading is an arrow (Flow.Balances.arrow_of_carries), exchange stops within the configurations under the first law (Flow.Balances.exchange_stops_of_carries), and a finite world that keeps exchanging forgets (World.forgets). Gathering: under exact conservation, every step enclosed, a record's level rises without end, gaining from beyond, in a world that is not finite (Gathering.gathers). Instances of the laws of change (R6, Becoming.Recurrence): revisiting after a change is revisiting (Web.Revisits.recurs), an arrow marks every change (Web.Arrow.marks), a merge along the family is a merge of the law (Web.Merges.law), and determined change runs along the law's orbit (Web.Determined.orbit); the first law keeps the configurations among those within the stock at T (Flow.Balances.held; this bound is the supplied Z), so from every step on the configuration takes one value twice, constructively (Flow.Balances.recurs), an arrow stops change (Flow.Balances.arrow_stops), within that bound a law merging nothing brings the start back (Flow.Balances.returns_of_lossless; the bound does the work, not losing alone: Law.succ_open merges nothing and never returns), the present forgets the kept history (Flow.Balances.present_forgets), and an arrow or dissipation rules out a law merging nothing (Flow.Balances.not_lossless_of_arrow, not_lossless_of_dissipates).

hypotheses.zh: 平衡（Flow.Balances，脊柱的）：历史的结论只用它。
hypotheses.en: Balance (Flow.Balances, the spine's): the results on the history use only this.

hypotheses.zh: 第一律（Flow.GainlessOn、Flow.Gainless：每个不重复的封闭家族得回的至多是所取）与无损（Flow.LosslessOn、Flow.Lossless）是定理的假设，不是公理；固定单位的自然数量。
hypotheses.en: The first law (Flow.GainlessOn, Flow.Gainless: every closed family without repetition gets back at most what is taken from it) and losing nothing (Flow.LosslessOn, Flow.Lossless) are hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms; natural-number amounts at a fixed unit.

hypotheses.zh: 确定的变化（Web.Determined：自 T 起下一步的构型是当前构型的函数）是合并定理的假设；脊柱的流以步为索引，不要求它。
hypotheses.en: Determined change (Web.Determined: from T on the next configuration is a function of the current one) is a hypothesis of the merging theorems; the spine's flow is indexed by steps and does not require it.

hypotheses.zh: 把记录算作一个条件是读法，依据 Ren 2026-10-11：“I know what "Every exchange loses at least one smallest amount" is now, it is entropy”与“pure thermodynamics, at atomic level, each exchange between objects holds the conservation of energy, but entropy still rise. zero premises.”。作者的读法（AI，待 Ren）：记录是在精确守恒之下仍增加的量。定理对是否这样读都成立：Flow.balances_withRecord 是恒等，不算入记录的规律也一并陈述。
hypotheses.en: Counting the record as a condition is a reading, following Ren on 11 October 2026: ‘I know what "Every exchange loses at least one smallest amount" is now, it is entropy’ and ‘pure thermodynamics, at atomic level, each exchange between objects holds the conservation of energy, but entropy still rise. zero premises.’ The author's reading (AI, pending Ren): the record is what rises while every exchange conserves exactly. The theorems hold under either reading: Flow.balances_withRecord is an identity, and the laws without the record are stated too.

correspondence.zh: 回答 Ren 的三个问题（AI 的读法，待 Ren）。零是否可能：可能，恰在无损之处；Ren 的业力读法在此是逆转之后水平没有差异，历史有差异。熵能否推出：不加前提地增加的是历史；有限围住的水平在变化继续时没有箭头，箭头或静止合并构型，在构型中守住历史使交换停止；最小损失恰是第一律加守恒量中的记录，是分解而不是推出。第二定律的形式：历史与耗散的量不减，后者连同存量守恒，按比例耗散时为取用定界，与量的规律（rest-at-every-resolution 的 Flow.uptake_bound）相合。与热力学的对应是读法，不是物理推导：Clausius（不减的量）；Boltzmann 的 W（configurations，即 Einstein 固体的多重度）；Zermelo 与 Poincaré 的复返（unending_change_revisits）；Loschmidt 的可逆性（no_arrow）；Landauer 的擦除（merges_of_settles）；Bennett 的可逆计算保存历史（World.forgets）；Gouy–Stodola 的可用功（dissipatesOn_iff_conserved、residues_lost）；开放系统（Gathering）。脊柱上的“水平恢复而历史不恢复”与 endpoint-loss-and-return 及 ReturnConditions.lean 中加入的计数器是同一区分，那里的结果先在；本结果是它在流与网上的形式，并把它连到第一律、耗散与构型的计数。
correspondence.en: Answers to Ren's three questions (the AI's reading, pending Ren). Is 0 possible: yes, exactly where lossless; in Ren's karmic reading, after a reverse the levels show no difference and the history does. Can entropy be derived: what rises with no premise is the history; the levels of a finite enclosure have no arrow while change goes on, an arrow or rest merges configurations, and holding the history in the configuration stops exchange; the least loss is exactly the first law with the record held in the conserved amount, a decomposition, not a derivation. The second-law form: the history and the amount dissipated never fall, the latter conserved with the stock and bounding uptake under loss in proportion, in keeping with the amount law (Flow.uptake_bound of rest-at-every-resolution). The correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations: Clausius (a never-decreasing quantity); Boltzmann's W (configurations, the Einstein solid's multiplicity); Zermelo's and Poincaré's recurrence (unending_change_revisits); Loschmidt's reversibility (no_arrow); Landauer's erasure (merges_of_settles); Bennett's reversible computation keeping its history (World.forgets); Gouy–Stodola's available work (dissipatesOn_iff_conserved, residues_lost); open systems (Gathering). On the spine, ‘the levels restored, the history not’ is the distinction already drawn by endpoint-loss-and-return and by the counter added in ReturnConditions.lean, which come first; this result is its form on the flow and web, connected to the first law, dissipation and the count of configurations.

detail.zh: 从不复返的证明用 Flow.rise_lowers_on 与 Flow.fall_lowers_on（被耗散的家族中成员上升或下降都使存量下降）；有限世界的结论用 World.rises_of_arises、World.falls_of_ceases 与 Flow.ExchangeRecurs。
detail.en: The proof of never revisiting uses Flow.rise_lowers_on and Flow.fall_lowers_on (a member rising or falling in a family dissipated on lowers the stock); the finite-world results use World.rises_of_arises, World.falls_of_ceases and Flow.ExchangeRecurs.

output.zh: 平衡与耗散之下，被耗散的家族中任何成员的水平变化都使家族的存量严格下降；体现之下生起即上升、止息即下降。
output.en: Under balance and dissipation, any change of a member's level in a family dissipated on strictly lowers the family's stock; under embodiment, arising is a rise and ceasing a fall.

input.zh: 构型变化之处有成员上升或下降（Web.changes_member），所以耗散之下存量在每次变化时严格下降，且从不上升，故不能复返。
input.en: Where the configuration changes some member rises or falls (Web.changes_member), so under dissipation the stock strictly falls at every change and never rises, and cannot come back.

conditions.zh: 平衡；家族自 T 起被耗散；不重复的家族。
conditions.en: Balance; the family dissipated on from T on; a family without repetition.

detail.zh: Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost 与 Flow.uptake_within_dissipated 用 Flow.DissipatesBy 与 Flow.DissipatesBy.replenishment_le。
detail.en: Flow.DissipatesBy.uptake_le_lost and Flow.uptake_within_dissipated use Flow.DissipatesBy and Flow.DissipatesBy.replenishment_le.

output.zh: 按比例 q 耗散时，q+1 乘家族得回的不多于 q 乘从它取走的，所以得回的不多于取走的。
output.en: Under loss in proportion q, q + 1 times what the family gets back is within q times what is taken from it, so what it gets back is within what is taken.

input.zh: 于是取走的等于得回的加失去的，取走的至多是失去的 q+1 倍。
input.en: So what is taken is what is got back with what is lost, and what is taken is at most q + 1 times what is lost.

conditions.zh: 按比例 q 耗散于家族（固定单位）。
conditions.en: Loss in proportion q on the family (at a fixed unit).

detail.zh: 实例定理用 Becoming.Recurrence 的 Revisits、revisits_of_held、revisits_from、Marks、Marks.change_stops、Law.orbit、Law.orbit_add、Law.Lossless、Law.Lossless.cancel、Law.Merges、Law.Merges.not_lossless、Law.Returns、Law.withHistory 与 Law.present_forgets。
detail.en: The instance theorems use Becoming.Recurrence's Revisits, revisits_of_held, revisits_from, Marks, Marks.change_stops, Law.orbit, Law.orbit_add, Law.Lossless, Law.Lossless.cancel, Law.Merges, Law.Merges.not_lossless, Law.Returns, Law.withHistory and Law.present_forgets.

output.zh: 不加前提：被一个列表容纳的序列复返（鸽巢，不用判定）；被标记的变化在有限多构型之内停止；不合并的规律在多个步上仍不合并；保留历史的展开中有限的当下遗忘。
output.en: With no premise: a sequence held by a list revisits (pigeonhole, without decidability); a marked change stops within finitely many configurations; a law merging nothing merges nothing over many steps; in an unfolding that keeps its history a finite present forgets.

input.zh: 家族自 T 起的构型是一个序列；变化是构型的函数时 next 是一个规律；第一律之下构型被其 T 时存量之内的构型列表容纳（Flow.Balances.held）。
input.en: The family's configurations from T on are a sequence; where change is a function of the configuration, next is a law; under the first law the configurations are held by the list of those within the stock at T (Flow.Balances.held).

conditions.zh: 平衡；家族自 T 起不得益（第一律）；回返与遗忘还要求变化自 T 起由 next 决定（Web.Determined）。
conditions.en: Balance; the family gaining nothing from T on (the first law); return and forgetting also need change determined by next from T on (Web.Determined).

detail.zh: 并行的读法：R4 把单位的细分算作只给不取的形成，本结果把交换的记录算作只被给予的条件；两者都不添前提而重读，R4 得到每一分辨率下的静止，本结果把最小损失分解为第一律与守恒量中的记录。R4 的下一步（最小损失能否推出、无损的交换是否存在）由本结果回答。
detail.en: A parallel reading: R4 counts the splitting of the unit as a formation that gives without taking; this result counts the record of the exchanges as a condition only given to. Both reread without adding a premise; R4 obtains rest at every resolution, and this result decomposes the least loss into the first law and the record in the conserved amount. It answers R4's next step (whether the least loss can be derived, whether lossless exchanges exist).

detail.zh: 先在的结果：沿实际历史，返回恰当保留全部端点可能；ReturnConditions.lean 中加入的计数器使原有的返回不再是返回。本结果的 restores_levels_not_history 是同一区分在流上的形式；未声称两者之间的形式转换。
detail.en: Prior results: along an actual history, return holds exactly where every endpoint possibility is kept; the counter added in ReturnConditions.lean makes a native return no longer a return. restores_levels_not_history here is the same distinction on the flow; no formal adapter between them is claimed.

detail.zh: 统一计划 R5：熵，按 Ren 2026-10-11 的问题，以不加前提的最强形式在先；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Unification plan R5: entropy, following Ren's questions of 11 October 2026, the strongest form without premise first; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: Passing：有限、平衡、无损、被围住，每次交换在下一步被逆转，不耗散，生起与止息复现，构型每两步回来，没有箭头，变化不合并任何构型，历史每步增长（Passing.passes、Passing.history_without_arrow）：第一律不推出静止，也不推出耗散。
detail.en: Passing: finite, balanced, lossless and enclosed, each exchange reversed at the next step, not dissipative, arising and ceasing recurring, its configuration coming back every two steps, with no arrow, its change merging no configurations, its history growing at every step (Passing.passes, Passing.history_without_arrow): the first law gives neither rest nor dissipation.

detail.zh: Settling：一个单位传递一次，无损，从不复返而静止，不耗散，静止合并了构型，接受单位一边的水平是箭头（Settling.settles、Settling.merges）：从不复返不推出耗散。
detail.en: Settling: one unit passes once, losslessly; the world never revisits and rests, is not dissipative, its rest merges configurations, and the level of the side receiving the unit is an arrow (Settling.settles, Settling.merges): never revisiting does not give dissipation.

detail.zh: Passing.record_needs_both：记录为零时家族连同记录不得增益而记录漏掉每次交换；每次记一个单位时记录记下每次交换而家族连同记录得益。
detail.en: Passing.record_needs_both: recording nothing, the family with its record gains nothing but the record misses every exchange; recording one unit each, the record holds every exchange but the family with it gains.

detail.zh: Gathering：精确守恒、每步被围住、交换复现，记录的水平是永不停止的箭头；记录从其外得益，世界不有限（Gathering.gathers）：no_arrow 的“家族不得增益”与 World.no_arrow 的“世界有限”都起作用。
detail.en: Gathering: exact conservation, every step enclosed, the exchange recurring, the record's level an arrow without end; the record gains from beyond, and the world is not finite (Gathering.gathers): the premises that the family gains nothing (no_arrow) and that the world is finite (World.no_arrow) do work.

limitations.zh: 离散步，固定单位的自然数量；“熵”指历史还是守恒量中的记录，由 Ren 决定；最小损失只被分解，没有被推出；确定的变化是合并定理的假设，merges_of_* 的结论是双重否定；只陈述了合并与否的二分；可达构型逐步收缩由 R6 给出（Law.Reachable.earlier、Law.lost_stays，任何确定的规律，不加前提），其在第一律的列表之内的计数没有陈述；粗粒化的熵从有序的开端上升需要关于开端的前提，没有陈述；算入记录的流以 Option 为条件，不是同一种关系项的世界；与热力学的对应是读法，不是物理推导；不含伦理谓词；尚无独立审查。
limitations.en: Discrete steps, natural-number amounts at a fixed unit; whether ‘entropy’ names the history or the record in the conserved amount is Ren's decision; the least loss is decomposed, not derived; determined change is a hypothesis of the merging theorems, and the conclusions of merges_of_* are double negations; only the dichotomy of merging or not is stated; that the reachable configurations shrink step by step is R6's (Law.Reachable.earlier, Law.lost_stays, any determined law, no premise), and their count within the first law's list is not stated; a coarse-grained entropy rising from an ordered start needs a premise about the start and is not stated; the flow with the record counted has Option conditions and is not a world of one kind of relatum; the correspondences to thermodynamics are readings, not physical derivations; no ethical predicate; not yet independently reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 由 Ren 决定“熵”的读法（历史或守恒量中的记录）；可达构型在第一律的列表之内的计数（逐步收缩已由 R6 的 Law.lost_stays 给出），以及不合并时可能全部保留；把记录作为普查中的关系项，使算入记录的流本身是一个世界；粗粒化的熵与关于开端的前提（外围）；连续时间与实数量；独立审查。
next_delta.en: Ren's decision on the reading of ‘entropy’ (the history or the record in the conserved amount); the count of reachable configurations within the first law's list (their shrinking is R6's Law.lost_stays), and every possibility kept where nothing merges; the record as a relatum in the census, so the counted flow is itself a world; a coarse-grained entropy and a premise about the start (periphery); continuous time and real amounts; an independent review.
